fact: The World Bank appraisal document (2023-12-22) for PACTDIGITAL includes a US$22.00m component on developing digital skills and a project aim to increase access to digital skills programs.
Agence Ecofin reports that the digital ministry's 2025 results included strengthening the digital skills of 169 young girls.

The organising committee chair, who is the digital ministry's secretary general, announced on 2026-11-09 a free ICT training campaign of about five weeks covering office software, AI, cybersecurity, networks, web and mobile development, with attention to youth, women, displaced people and people with disabilities.
